verdict.rationale: Netlify's official CLI (`netlify deploy`) runs from the terminal, and its REST API is documented as "ideal for automating workflows"; together these give scriptable, headless operation that fits CI use. Git-push auto-deploys and community reports of automated builds and deploys corroborate this. missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (non-interactive auth tokens, CI flags or recipes), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), hands-on evidence of the CLI running inside a CI pipeline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Manage sites, deploys, DNS, and more programmatically with the Netlify REST API—ideal for automating workflows and integrating into your systems.
Deploy sites, run local dev servers, and manage your Netlify projects right from the terminal with this powerful command-line tool.
